feature: Native generated images in assistant messages

protocol.message_content: Markdown image with a waku-blob: reference

build.skip_reason: Existing opt-in S3 integration test requires private configuration

automated_coverage: Ordered text and multiple image chunks, including fragmented Markdown
Local atomic snapshot restoration and fresh server history projection
Image reference belongs to the displayed assistant message
PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP MIME types and filename extensions
Cached images remain readable after recreating the cache object offline
Missing bytes, corrupt bytes, corrupt index and full cache eviction trigger a new read
Profile isolation and concurrent duplicate download suppression
Failed and cancelled downloads remain retryable
Invalid references, response types, Base64, formats and oversized responses are rejected
Incomplete Markdown and fenced examples do not render as images

device_validation.backend: Local synthetic Waku v12 fixture using readBlob; no provider generation call
passed: Fresh server history renders the generated image inline
Image preview opens with the full image and a Save button
Saving from preview writes PNG to Download/deerflow
Saved file is byte-for-byte identical to the server fixture
Force-stop and restart restore the image without another blob read
Force-stop and restart offline restore the cached image
Evicting image bytes while offline displays a retryable error
Reconnecting automatically reloads the missing image without regenerating it
device_validation.blob_read_explanation: One initial download, one after explicit image cache eviction

limitations: Production image generation was not invoked
Images are previewed as static bitmaps
A missing local cache requires the server to retain the original blob
